description: This PHP class defines EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams, a data transfer object (DTO) used to specify filtering parameters for searching employee skills, including setting and getting employee numbers and defining sortable fields.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams, used for filtering employee skill search results based on employee number and sortable fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
